page.overview:
Who is Crusherguts?

It is possible for Bruisers to attain big reputations although few would claim to be more famous than Blogg Crusherguts, the huge enforcer for the Rock Skulls tribe. Blogg perfected a move that others called 'the Crusherguts in his honour. Upon entering battle, Blogg could hurl his bulk so that it struck like a beefy thunderbolt, breaking a battle line with a resounding crash. It was said that foes struck by the Crusherguts were so shocked by the impact that Ogres could just reach down and pluck them off the ground for eating.
